content.short: Hydromancer offers low-latency Hyperliquid APIs, streaming, historical datasets and node peering.
content.description: Hydromancer supplies the data infrastructure around Hyperliquid that trading teams would otherwise build themselves: rate-limit-free APIs, low-latency streams, historical order book datasets and node peering. Its Builder APIs handle batch operations across thousands of wallets through endpoints such as builderFills and builderLiquidations. Order book streaming covers L2 and L4 with address visibility, which the native API does not expose, and market snapshots are stored as Parquet at one-second resolution. More than fifty teams build on it, including Based, Dexari, Felix and OneKey.
